decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly ramping up mana and tutoring for key combo pieces, such as Primeval Titan and Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle, using Amulet of Vigor to untap lands for explosive plays. The goal is to assemble the combo to deal large amounts of damage with Valakut triggers or overwhelm the opponent with multiple Primeval Titan triggers. The deck also includes utility lands and creatures like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to fix mana and provide additional benefits. Overall, the strategy revolves around efficiently assembling the combo while managing resources effectively.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The deck includes powerful creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ranger-Captain of Eos, along with efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge. The inclusion of cards like Static Prison and Arena of Glory helps to control the board and protect your creatures while dealing damage. By efficiently managing resources and applying pressure early on, this deck aims to secure a fast victory against the opponent in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The Boros Aggro deck focuses on utilizing fast and aggressive creatures like Amped Raptor and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to apply early pressure on the opponent. It also includes powerful cards like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to maintain board dominance. The deck also runs disruptive cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of Aether Hub and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker allows for mana fixing and card advantage, making this deck a formidable force in the Modern format.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's resources through hand disruption cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek, removal spells like Fatal Push, and powerful creatures like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent with cards like Necrodominance and Fell the Profane while maintaining control of the game. Additionally, the deck includes cards like The One Ring and Soul Spike for added reach and finishing power. The deck focuses on slowly grinding down the opponent's resources and overpowering them with its powerful spells and creatures.

The deck focuses on assembling a variety of creature toolbox options to create a powerful combo win condition by tutoring for specific creatures using Chord of Calling and Summoner's Pact. It includes cards like Shuko, Delighted Halfling, Springheart Nantuko, and Thassa's Oracle to generate value and set up the combo, while also utilizing cards like Outrider en-Kor, Endurance, and Wall of Roots for protection and acceleration. The deck aims to efficiently find and deploy the necessary pieces to overwhelm the opponent and secure victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures and sacrificing them for value, utilizing cards like Goblin Bombardment and Marionette Apprentice. It also incorporates a companion creature, Jegantha, the Wellspring, to provide additional mana. The deck includes cards that synergize well with sacrificing creatures, such as Ocelot Pride and Amped Raptor, to maintain pressure on the opponent. Players can use cards like Fatal Push and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to control the board while maintaining their aggressive strategy. The deck includes a mix of lands to support the color requirements of the cards in the deck.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage while utilizing The One Ring as a win condition. The deck includes a mix of control cards such as Counterspell, Galvanic Discharge, and Wrath of the Skies to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, the deck features card advantage tools like Teferi, Time Raveler and Meticulous Archive to stay ahead in the game. The inclusion of Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury adds a powerful threat to close out games quickly. Overall, this deck aims to outlast opponents and secure victory through control and powerful finishers.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Mine, Urza's Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. This mana is then used to play powerful and expensive colorless spells such as Ugin, the Spirit Dragon, Karn Liberated, and All Is Dust to control the game and eliminate threats. The deck also utilizes cards like Expedition Map and Ancient Stirrings to search for key pieces, while including other win conditions like Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and The One Ring to close out the game.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate massive amounts of mana quickly. The key strategy is to control the board with powerful Eldrazi creatures, disrupt the opponent's plans with Thought-Knot Seer, and create a lock-down situation with Karn, the Great Creator. Sowing Mycospawn helps to ramp up mana production even further, while cards like Kozilek's Command and All Is Dust provide additional removal and board control. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with big threats and powerful abilities.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy through discard spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Fell the Profane. The deck aims to control the board and grind out incremental advantage with powerful threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Grief. The deck also utilizes efficient removal like Soul Spike and March of Wretched Sorrow to deal with opposing threats. Overall, the deck focuses on controlling the game and out-valuing the opponent through resource denial and powerful creatures.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures and disrupting the opponent's game plan with hand disruption and removal spells. By utilizing a mixture of powerful creatures and disruption tools, the deck aims to pressure the opponent and control the board to secure a swift victory. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion provides additional value and flexibility to the deck. This Mardu Aggro deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent through a combination of speed, disruption, and efficient threats.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to utilize the power of aggressive creatures like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls, combined with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge, to quickly deal damage to the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury to provide additional support and synergies. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison help disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Jegantha, the Wellspring and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer offer additional utility and versatility in the deck.

The main concept of this deck revolves around utilizing powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Ulamog, the Defiler to control the game. The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using cards like Eldrazi Temple and Through the Breach to cheat out these expensive threats early. Additionally, cards like All Is Dust and Kozilek's Command help control the board while cards like Ancient Stirrings and Thought-Knot Seer help filter through the deck for key pieces. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with huge creatures and powerful spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing a variety of creatures with different abilities to create a synergistic combo that can overwhelm the opponent. It incorporates cards that generate mana, provide protection, and have recursive abilities. By using Chord of Calling, the player can search for specific creatures needed for the combo, while also having access to Yawgmoth, Thran Physician for additional card draw and removal options. The toolbox approach allows for flexibility in adapting to different matchups and situations, while aiming to outvalue the opponent in the long run.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly with Eldrazi Temple and Utopia Sprawl to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. It also utilizes control elements such as Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's strategies. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with massive Eldrazi threats while controlling the board with removal spells and disruption. The deck aims to dominate the late game with its powerful creatures and control elements, ultimately leading to victory.

Utilizing a variety of creatures and spells, this deck aims to assemble a toolbox approach to combo off and generate value. By tutoring for specific creatures with cards like Chord of Calling and Birthing Ritual, the deck can quickly assemble game-winning combos such as Marionette Apprentice and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician. The inclusion of versatile cards like Eternal Witness and Grist, the Hunger Tide allow for flexibility and resilience against opposing strategies. With a mix of disruptive elements and combo pieces, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its creature-based synergy.
